catalog.abstention: Abstain when the available evidence cannot support a route. Missing noise or intent cannot support likely_noise or likely_intended respectively.
catalog.text: Which route best describes this changed capture given validity, deltas, noise, intent and region facts?

catalog.abstention: Abstain when the necessary visual fact or useful inspection scope cannot be determined; human_directly records a separate need for human judgment.
catalog.text: What minimum visual inspection is needed to resolve the task's uncertainty in this exact structured packet?

catalog.abstention: Abstain when evidence cannot support a disposition. Explicit gaps can support collect_more_evidence, never a qualified speedup or causal claim.
catalog.text: Which disposition is supported by the qualified deterministic performance findings and declared intervention?

catalog.abstention: Abstain when no disposition can be supported. Missing or invalid deterministic evidence cannot be overridden by continue_review.
catalog.text: What action is supported by the validity checks, convergence, expected content and capture context?

catalog.abstention: Abstain when intent or attributed observations cannot settle the relationship. Missing or lower-assurance intent may support insufficient_intent.
catalog.text: Which answer best describes the observed changes against the declared intent?

scope_reference.inspect_full_frame: declared global appearance change or constructed temporal context
scope_reference.inspect_regions: localized unintended artifact or semantic HUD change whose meaning is absent from structured features
scope_reference.text_sufficient: exact identity, measured repeat envelope, or explicit metadata and qualification gaps

truth_policy: Construction and recorded outcomes under section 16. Hidden references are independent of provider outputs.
